full_judgment: 2. The case of the plaintiff, in brief, is that the jote appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 89 of mouza Pali Moheshpur under P.S. Dhupchachia District Bogra measuring 1.90 decitnah originally belonged to Rajmohon Shaba and Ramkumar Shaba in equal share. That Rajmohan Shaba died leaving 4 sons Mohabharas Shaha. Bhagabat Chandra Shaba, Basanta Kumar Shaba, Gakul Chandra Shaha as his heirs. That Mohabharat Shaha died leaving one son Norendra Nath Shaha who afterwards died issueless and the aforesaid Basanta Kumar Shaba and Cokul Chandra Shaba also died leaving plaintiff No. 2 as his only son and as such he acquired /8/- annas share in the suit jote. That Ramkumar Shaha died leaving 2 sons Kesha b Chandra and Okhy Kumar Shaha. That Keshab Chandra Shaha died leaving 4 sons, Shirts Chandra, Khithish Chandra Shaha, Jogoballav Shaha, and Radhaballav Shaha and being in possession over their /4/-annas share sold to pro-defdt. Nos. 7-11 by registered Kabalas. That Akhoy Kumar Shaha died leaving one son plff. No. 1 as his heir and as such the plaintiffs and pro-defdt. are in a ejmali possession over the suit jote That in M.R.R. the suit jote have been recorded in the name of Rajmohon Shaha, Bhagabat Chandra Shaha, Mohabharat Chandra Shaha, Gokul Chandra Shah; Keshab Chandra Shaha, Rajmohon Shaha. Basanta Kumar Shaha, Akhoy Kumar Shah along with pro-defdt. Nos. 7-11. That the said M.R.R. record is wrong since the same has been prepared in the name of their predecessor-in-interest who died long ago. That the pro-defdt. No. 10 used to look after the suit jote from the time of their predecessor-in-interest and being in possession of all papers managed to start the certificate Case No. 697-B-60-61 against the dead persons and has auction purchased the same in the name of his sons and nephews the defdt. Nos. 26 by suppressing all the notices in collusion with the staff, That no delivery of possession took place nor they were aware about the alleged certificate Sale but first came to know from one Nader Mon-dal who alleged to have reported him (the plaintiff No.1) about their (defdt. No.2-6) alleged auction purchase on 31.1.78, A.D. and being aware they have come to know in details on 4.2.78 A.D after having certified copy of the said certificate case. Hence the plaintiff filed this suit.
